mathematics.assertion_tested: Exact polynomial, determinant, radial Jacobian, gauge, measure and rational constant controls for three separately pinned bosonic addenda.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Rational, Gaussian rational, real algebraic and symbolic expressions; no floating-point theorem tests.
mathematics.conventions: A=UZU*Z*, real alpha in [0,1], eigenvalues counted with algebraic multiplicity; ordinary coordinate Lebesgue measure.

bounds.matrices: 28 Jordan-similarity fixtures d=1..4, seven eigenvalues and five alpha values; 24 sharpness cases; one nonnormal 4x4 body at five alpha values
bounds.symbolic: One exact polynomial identity, one AM-GM identity, one 2D Jacobian, one disk integral, finite constants and domain/gauge controls
bounds.resources: 120 seconds wall; 90 seconds per-process CPU; 2 GiB virtual memory; one core; cooperative one thread

non_claims: Does not prove universal or asymptotic statements by enumeration
No SUSY integral or source conclusions
